title: Full Stack Developer (Web & Cloud)
description: Seeking an agile Full Stack Developer capable of delivering end-to-end features from responsive React frontend user interfaces to robust backend API services and database persistence.
responsibilities: Build responsive web applications using React, TypeScript, and modern styling frameworks.
Develop backend web APIs using Node.js, FastAPI, or Django.
Manage database schema migrations and queries in PostgreSQL or MySQL.
Ensure security, authentication (JWT/OAuth), and automated testing across the stack.
requirements: 3+ years building full stack web applications.
Strong skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, React, and Python or Node.js.
Solid relational database experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL.
Experience with Docker, Git, and cloud services (AWS/GCP).
